description: This file is a shell script used for bumping the Linux kernel version within the OpenWrt build environment. It defines functions for preparing, executing, and cleaning up a kernel bump process, including git operations and environment checks.

methods.name: _msg
methods.description: Prints messages with levels (err, warning, notice) to standard output or error.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information about the script.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Restores git state and traps cleanup functions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes variables, checks environment, and prepares for kernel bump.

methods.name: bump_kernel
methods.description: Performs the kernel version update, including git operations and renaming files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point, parses options and orchestrates the script's execution.
